decisions.statement: A process is over its ceiling on resident memory rather than on shared memory.
A tree is weighed on the proportional memory its whole subtree has.
A supervisor sitting under another supervisor is no tree root of its own.
Memory a per-process kill already reclaims is left out of its tree's total.
A leg says why that leg decided as that leg did whether or not that leg decided to kill.

definition: whether one process or one supervisor tree is over its memory ceiling
